task: Microscopic mechanism of scissors mode quenching and fragmentation in odd-A deformed nuclei

primary_papers: Margraf et al., Phys. Rev. C 52, 2429 (1995)
Lo Iudice, Stoyanov, Sushkov, Phys. Rev. C 57, 1018 (1998)
evidence_boundaries.mechanistic_law: Establishes that the Scissors Mode B(M1) strength in odd-A deformed nuclei (155Gd, 163Dy) is quenched by 35-40% and fragmented into >25 sub-branches compared to adjacent even-even cores (156Gd, 162Dy) due to two synergistic microscopic drivers: (1) Pauli blocking of the Fermi-surface Nilsson orbit eliminates key constructive 2qp channels, causing an 18% intrinsic sum-rule loss, and (2) A 15-fold explosion in 3qp background state density at 3 MeV fragments the collective phonon via particle-core coupling into a quasi-continuum, pushing ~22% of the strength below experimental NRF detection thresholds.
